verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into GitCafe itself. The per-issue/PR button only hands work off to external coding agents (Amp, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). The MCP server and WebMCP expose GitCafe tools to outside agents, and agent skills equip the user's own assistant. These are adjacent integration features, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit for this story.
